sloka: तस्य बुद्धिः समुप्तन्ना तपः कुर्यामनुत्तमम् ।तपो हि परमं श्रेयः सम्मोहमितरत्सुखम् ।। ७.८४.९ ॥
transliteration: tasya buddhiḥ samuptannā tapaḥ kuryāmanuttamam ।tapo hi paramaṁ śreyaḥ sammohamitaratsukham ।। 7.84.9 ॥

translations.english: A thought arose in his mind that he should perform unsurpassed penance, for indeed, penance is the supreme good, while other forms of happiness lead to delusion.
